7337422.baseName: Argos Home Pack Of 49 Shatterproof Christmas Baubles - Gold
7337422.variantName: Argos Home Pack Of 49 Shatterproof Christmas Baubles - Gold
7337422.sourceDescription: Dress your tree in golden warmth this Christmas with this pack of 49 shatterproof baubles. They're ready to hang straight from the box with threads already attached, so you can get decorating without the faff. The polystyrene build means they won't break if they take a tumble, making them a smart choice for busy homes or if you've got little ones around. You're getting 49 baubles in total, giving you plenty to fill out your tree from top to bottom or spread the golden glow across multiple rooms. The shatterproof design takes the stress out of decorating and packing away each year. They're made for indoor use, so pop them on your tree, drape them on garlands, or scatter them around your festive display however feels right. . 49 decorations included.; Contains gold pre-threaded baubles.; Made from polystyrene.; Shatterproof.; Suitable for indoor usage.

pf9cn196.sourceDescription: Bring the magic of a snowy woodland into your home with the Chamonix Spruce Flocked Christmas Tree from Christow. A beautiful festive centrepiece, it looks stunning decorated with lights, baubles, and all your favourite Christmas ornaments. This 8ft version is designed for a festive seasonal display. • Snow-Flocked Finish: With a full-bodied shape and rich green colour, the Chamonix Spruce recreates the look of a real spruce in winter. • Hinged Branch Construction: Built with hinged branches for quick and easy assembly, the Chamonix Spruce is simple to set up. • Sturdy Green Metal Stand: Each Chamonix Spruce includes a durable green metal stand with silver eyebolts to keep your tree upright and secure. Specifications: • Brand: Christow • Dimensions: H240cm x W145cm x D145cm • Colour: Green • Material: PVC • Lights: Unlit • Tree shape: Full • Weight: 11.6kg For decorative use only. Not a toy. Ensure the tree is securely assembled and positioned on a stable surface. Keep away from heat and naked flames. Read and follow all instructions and safety warnings before use. Wilton Bradley Ltd, 8 Wentworth Road, Heathfield Industrial Estate, Newton Abbot, Devon, TQ12 6TL

njetvees.baseName: Living and Home 7FT Snow Flocked Christmas Tree - White
njetvees.variantName: Living and Home 7FT Snow Flocked Christmas Tree - White
njetvees.sourceDescription: Winter's romance starts with a white Christmas tree. Not the loud, busy kind—quiet, standing there like a tree grown from a snow-covered fairytale, clean and pure, soft enough to make you pause. The branches layer beautifully, full and natural—not the sparse plastic look, worth a second glance from near or far. A sturdy metal base holds it steady, no wobbling, even when fully decorated. Assembly is simple—no complex tools, one person can set it up in no time. String warm fairy lights, hang a few silver ornaments, or drape delicate white ribbons—it doesn't need much; it's already beautiful. It's more than a tree. It's the corner of winter magic in your home—and when the lights come on, the season takes shape. Overall Dimension: W80 x D80 x H210cm Recycle your tree through a community program where available. SYL Moda Trading LTD, Po Box 148, Manchester, M266BJ, United Kingdom

85026vd2.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
85026vd2.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
85026vd2.sourceDescription: This modern artificial Christmas tree exudes a sleek, contemporary style perfect for those who appreciate minimalistic elegance. Defined by its clean lines and functional design, this piece seamlessly blends into both indoor and outdoor settings, offering a sophisticated touch to your festive decor. Its attractive cone shape and warm LED lighting transform any space into a winter wonderland, creating a cozy atmosphere for families and guests. Materials: Constructed from high-quality PVC, this modern artificial Christmas tree provides a sense of real evergreen foliage without the maintenance of a live tree. The use of PVC ensures durability and a lifelike appearance that stays vibrant season after season. Its green hue complements any holiday decor with elegance. Included Components: Equipped with LED strip lights and a USB plug, this tree offers convenient, safe lighting. The LEDs emit a warm white glow, filling your space with an inviting ambiance. Easily adjustable, these lights let you craft the perfect atmosphere at your holiday gatherings. Decorative Features: This tree features simple yet striking decorations that enhance its sleek modern look. The decorative accents lend an air of elegance and sophistication, turning your living area or outdoor space into a holiday sanctuary. Recommended Uses: Ideal for various settings, from cozy living rooms to open terraces. Its compact yet prominent presence adapts beautifully to small spaces or as a centerpiece in larger rooms, offering flexibility in decorating styles. Care &Maintenance: For best results, cover the tree when not in use to protect from dust and debris. A certified 5V USB power source is required to operate the tree's LED lights, ensuring optimal performance throughout the holiday season. Product Specifications Colour: White PVC and plastic and steel and PE Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 63 cm Stand size: 35 x 35 cm Hinged Branches for Easy Setup Lifelike Tips Snow Flocked Number of PE tips: 130 Number of PVC tips: 345 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 150 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree 1 x Foldable stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
